reason: Confirmed: `received_at` is taken at the start of `receive` (server/src/telemetry.rs:90), before the identity check, the body read and `BEGIN IMMEDIATE`, and `store` writes it with a plain `UPDATE devices SET last_contact = ?` (line 173). Two accepted requests from one device can commit out of order (a slow body or a lock wait under the 5 s busy timeout), which moves the last contact back to an older reception. That breaks FR-TELEMETRY-002 read with the glossary ('última vez visto': when the device was last heard from), and the fix is one line.
todo: server/src/telemetry.rs:173: never move the last contact backwards, e.g. `UPDATE devices SET last_contact = MAX(COALESCE(last_contact, 0), ?) WHERE id = ?` (the COALESCE is needed because SQLite's multi-argument MAX returns NULL if any argument is NULL). Keep each fix's own `received_at`. Add a test that proves an older reception committed after a newer one leaves the newer last contact.
